title: Power of Ten Launch
premise: Multiplying by 10, 100 or 1,000 shifts every digit to a bigger place. It is not just about sticking zeros on the end.
idea: Explaining patterns in the zeros of a product when multiplying by powers of 10. Adding zeros to a decimal (3.2 × 10 = 3.20) is the known slip.
author: claude-stand-in
